answer: Each identity anchors to one registered weather station sealed on-chain. Every epoch the station signs a fresh microclimate curve bound to the epoch nonce. Each curve carries a unique pigment: no two rooftops share one. Two identities reporting the same curve collapse to one vote and both stakes burn. A farm wanting a hundred votes must buy a hundred stations at about $150 each, each needing a 30-day history; one honest user certifies one station. The kernel of the defence is physics: weather cannot be faked in bulk, and the nebula of fakes dissolves when every vote brings its own sky.
